curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the monthly pressure check and the penny tread test.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on checking, reading and adjusting pressure and judging tread.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Items on gauge readings and the penny test result.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Set the seat, wheel distance and head restraint before driving.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on posture, pedal reach, wheel height and chest distance.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Items on the seat and head restraint limits.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain the rearview mirror and the enhanced outside mirror settings.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on each mirror's purpose and setting method.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Items on left versus right mirror methods and the extra view.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the primary belt law, correct belt fit and how air bags work with belts.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on enforcement, harness and lap belt fit, and air bags.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Items on primary enforcement and belt placement.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk through the child restraint stages from rear-facing to adult belt.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on each stage's age, seat and belt rule.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario items that place a child in the right restraint.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain the unsecured load law and how to secure cargo.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on the penalty, the definition of secure and tie-down methods.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Items on what makes a load secure.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain what assistance features do, their limits and test-day rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on alerts versus intervention, examples and driver responsibility.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Items on features banned on the test and staying engaged.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec05-m01..sec05-m07; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

domain_emphasis_check.domain: Before you drive: vehicle inspection, seating and mirrors, safety belts, air bags, child passengers, loads and driver assistance features

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
